blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Routed low-rank adapters offer a parameter-efficient means to improve the performance of large language models (LLMs) across tasks. Hence, it is assumed that they can also be used to improve the support of low-resource languages in LLMs, which currently serve English far better than the thousands of other languages spoken worldwide. However, this assumption has never been verified empirically under a shared multilingual evaluation protocol. We address exactly this gap by comparing eight low-rank adaptation (LoRA) methods on a frozen base model using 200 unique languages in more than 9{,}000 evaluation settings. Our results suggest that a reduced-scale search can identify viable configurations of LoRA methods but does not reliably predict their relative performance, as the top-ranking configuration is never best at scale. LoRA reliably improves language-model fit on translation data, consistently degrades reading comprehension, and benefits low-resource languages most. These findings suggest that LoRA methods should be regarded as targeted tools rather than general-purpose means for improving the multilingual capabilities of LLMs.
blocks.zh: 路由低等适配器提供了一个参数效率高的手段来改善大型语言模型(LLM)跨任务的表现. 因此,据推测,这些语言也可以用来改进对LLMs中资源不足语言的支持,目前这些语言比全世界数千种其他语言的英语服务要好得多。 然而,这一假设从未在共同的多语种评价协议下经过经验验证。 我们正视这一差距,在9{}000多个评价设置中,用200种独特的语言,在一个被冻结的基模上比较了八种低等适应(LORA)方法。 我们的结果显示,缩小规模的搜索可以确定LORA方法的可行配置,但无法可靠地预测其相对性能,因为顶级配置在规模上从未达到最佳. LoRA可靠地改进了适合翻译数据的语言模式,持续地降低阅读理解度,并且对资源匮乏的语言受益最大。 这些调查结果表明,LORA方法应被视为有针对性的工具,而不是提高LLMs多语种能力的一般用途手段。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are trained on data that are highly unevenly distributed across languages. English constitutes a substantial share of the training corpora used for widely deployed models such as Llama 3, whereas many other languages are represented by far less data Dubey et al. (2024) . This disparity contributes to lower and less reliable performance beyond English, particularly for low-resource languages Üstün et al. (2024) ; Asai et al. (2024) ; Ojo et al. (2025) . Addressing this gap therefore requires compute-efficient methods for extending existing models to many languages, rather than training a separate model for each one.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)接受不同语言之间分布极不均匀的数据培训. 英语在Llama 3等广泛部署的模型中使用的训练军团中占有很大比例,而许多其他语言则用数据Dubey等人(2024年)所代表。 这种差异导致英语之外的业绩更低、更不可靠,特别是低资源语言Ustün等人(2024年);Asai等人(2024年);Ojo等人(2025年)。 因此,要解决这一差距,就必须采用计算效率高的方法,将现有模式推广到许多语言,而不是为每种语言培训一个单独的模式。

blocks.en: Continued pretraining (CPT) on multilingual data can add language coverage without training a new model from scratch. However, joint training also creates competition for limited model capacity. Updates that help one language can have little effect on another or can reduce its performance, a pattern described as negative interference or the curse of multilinguality Aharoni et al. (2019) ; Wu and Dredze (2020) ; Wang et al. (2020) ; Conneau et al. (2020) . Multilingual adaptation therefore needs to balance parameter sharing, language-specific capacity, and training cost.
blocks.zh: 关于多语种数据的继续预训(CPT)可以增加语言覆盖面,而不从头开始培训新的模式. 然而,联合培训也为有限的示范能力创造了竞争。 有助于一种语言对另一种语言影响不大或能降低其性能的更新,这种模式被描述为负面干扰或多语种的诅咒Aharoni等 (2019年); Wu and Dredze (2020年); Wang等 (2020年); Conneau等 (2020年). 因此,多种语言适应需要平衡参数共享、语言能力和培训费用。

blocks.en: Running CPT Gururangan et al. (2020) ; Ke et al. (2023) at scale is expensive, which has made parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) the practical way to adapt large models. Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) freezes the base model and learns a single low-rank update Hu et al. (2022) . Because every language passes through those same parameters, LoRA cannot allocate capacity per language and leaves the interference problem largely unresolved. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) extensions of LoRA target this limitation directly. They replace the single update with several low-rank experts that are shared or selected by a routing rule Liu et al. (2024) ; Zadouri et al. (2024) , adding capacity at low cost and letting different experts specialize. Such specialization can align with language structure. Indeed, routing in multilingual MoE models has been observed to correlate with implicit phylogenetic language groups Srivastava et al. (2025) , making MoE–LoRA a natural candidate for balancing shared and language-specific capacity during multilingual CPT. However, whether this additional structure actually leads to significantly better results remains an unsolved problem.
blocks.zh: 运行 CPT Gurururangan等人(2020年);Ke等人(2023年)规模昂贵,这使得参数效率高的微调(PEFT)成为了改造大型模型的实际方法. Low-Rank Adaption (LORA) 冻结了基础模型,并学会了单个低级更新的Hu等 (2022). 由于每种语言都经过同样的参数,LORA无法分配每个语言的能力,使干扰问题基本上得不到解决. LoRA的Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)扩展直接针对这个限制. 他们用一些低级专家取代了单一更新,这些专家由一条路线规则Liu等人(2024年);Zadouri等人(2024年)共享或挑选,以低成本增加能力,并让不同的专家专业化。 这种专业化可与语言结构相适应。 事实上,据观察,多语种教育部模式的路由与Srivastava等人(2025年)隐含的生理语言群体相关,使得教育部-洛拉省成为在多语种CPT期间平衡共享能力和语言能力的自然候选者。 然而,这一额外结构是否真正导致显著改善结果仍然是一个尚未解决的问题。

blocks.en:
This question is all the more relevant when one considers that most MoE–LoRA methods were developed and validated for multi-task settings such as medical adaptation and instruction tuning Liu et al. (2024) ; Zadouri et al. (2024) , rather than for multilingual learning. The few efforts that extend them to multilingual settings
each commit to a single design. MLAS-LoRA uses language-general and language-specific LoRA modules for machine translation Dong et al. (2025) , and MoE-LPR adds experts to a pretrained model with language-aware routing Zhou et al. (2025a) .
However, no prior work systematically compares MoE–LoRA methods using the same base model, training data, and evaluation protocol for multilingual CPT. We address this gap through a controlled comparison that evaluates both aggregate performance and variation across tasks and languages.
blocks.zh:
如果考虑到大多数教育部-LORA方法是针对多个任务环境,如医学适应和教学调整Liu等人(2024年);Zadouri等人(2024年),而不是针对多语种学习,那么这个问题就更加相关了。 将其扩展到多语种环境的少数努力
每个都致力于一个单一的设计。 MLAS-LORA在机器翻译Dong等(2025)中使用了语言通俗和语言特有的LORA模块,而MOE-LPR则在预训模式中添加了专家,并配有语言意识的路由周等(2025a).
然而,以前的工作没有系统地比较使用同一基础模型的MOE-LORA方法、培训数据和多语种CPT的评价协议。 我们通过对照比较来弥补这一差距,这种比较既评价总体业绩,又评价不同任务和语言之间的差异。

blocks.en: Concretely, we compare eight parameter-efficient adaptation methods using a frozen Llama-3.1-8B base model. The search stages comprise 132 training runs on ten languages, including the longer follow-up on 22 combined configurations. We then carry the five best configurations, together with two plain-LoRA baselines, to fourteen broader runs covering 96 and 200 training languages, for 146 independent training runs in total. Four multilingual benchmarks evaluate reading comprehension, language-model fit on translation data, topic classification, and text classification, which gives each trained configuration around 70 benchmark and language measurements, 10,842 altogether.
blocks.zh: 具体来说,我们用冷冻的Llama-3.1-8B基准模型比较了8个参数高效的适应方法。 搜索阶段包括132次以10种语言进行的培训,包括对22个组合进行更长时间的后续培训。 然后,我们将五个最佳组合以及两个平原-LORA基线带到涵盖96个语言和200个培训语言的14个范围更广的业务,共计146个独立培训。 四个多语种基准评价阅读理解度、适合翻译数据的语文模式、专题分类和文本分类,使每个训练有素的配置约70个基准和语文计量,共计10 842个。

blocks.en: We organize the study around four questions: 1. How do rank and expert count affect multilingual performance? 2. How do MoE–LoRA methods compare under a shared multilingual evaluation? 3. Do the strongest methods remain effective under broader multilingual training conditions? 4. Which tasks and languages benefit most from MoE–LoRA adaptation?
blocks.zh: 我们围绕四个问题组织研究: 1. 军衔和专家人数如何影响多语种业绩? 2. 在共同的多语种评价下,内政部-洛拉方法如何比较? 3. 在更广泛的多语种培训条件下,最强有力的方法是否仍然有效? 4. 哪些任务和语言从教育部-LORA的适应中受益最大?

blocks.zh: 军衔和专家人数如何影响多语种的表现?

blocks.en: How do MoE–LoRA methods compare under a shared multilingual evaluation?

blocks.zh: 在更广泛的多语种培训条件下,最有力的方法是否仍然有效?

blocks.en: Which tasks and languages benefit most from MoE–LoRA adaptation?
blocks.zh: 哪些任务和语言从LORA部的适应中受益最大?

blocks.en: We contribute a controlled comparison of routed low-rank experts under massively multilingual continued pretraining, which yields three key findings: (i) low ranks win consistently, so the best-performing setting also trains the fewest parameters; (ii) a reduced-scale search finds configurations that remain viable at scale but does not reliably predict how they rank there; and (iii) what transfers instead is the direction of the effect, with gains concentrated on translation fit and on lower-resource languages. We release the protocol, per-language results, and code so that a new method can enter the same comparison. 1 1 1 https://github.com/dice-group/moe-study
blocks.zh: 我们在大规模多语种持续预训下对路由低级专家进行有控制的比较,得出三个主要结论:(一) 低级持续取胜,因此业绩最佳的设置也训练出最少的参数;(二) 缩小规模的搜索发现的配置在规模上仍然可行,但不能可靠地预测它们在那里的排名;(三) 何种转移是效果的方向,成果集中在翻译合适和资源较少的语言上。 我们发布协议,每个语言的结果,以及代码,这样新的方法就可以输入同样的比较. 1 1 1 https://github.com/dice-group/moe-study

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: In this section, abbreviations in bold indicate the baselines used in our experiments.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,粗体缩略语表示我们实验中使用的基线。

blocks.en:
Jacobs et al. (1991) introduced a modular supervised learning framework in which multiple expert networks are trained on disjoint subsets of the data.
Following the transformer architecture Vaswani et al. (2017) , sparse MoE became a primary approach for reducing the computational cost of LLMs ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; Fedus et al., 2022 ; Ludziejewski et al., 2024 ) , and MoEs empirically outperform dense counterparts at a fixed computational budget, particularly at large scale and with well-optimized routing ( Zoph et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Cai et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
Jacobs等人(1991年)引入了一个模块化监督学习框架,在该框架中,多个专家网络接受了数据分集断开的培训。
继变压器架构Vaswani等人(2017年)后,稀有的教育部成为了降低LLMs计算成本的主要方法(Shazeer等人,2017年;Fedus等人,2022年;Ludziejewski等人,2024年),而MOEs在经验上在固定计算预算上,特别是在大规模和优化路线上比密集的对应方要好(Zoph等人,2022年;Zhang等人,2024年;Cai等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
PEFT methods Ding et al. (2023) attain comparable performance to full fine - tuning while updating only a fraction of the parameters.
The most widely adopted of them, LoRA Hu et al. (2022) , trains only low - rank perturbations to selected weight matrices, which reduces memory usage. It also generalizes robustly Xin et al. (2024) and better maintains the base model’s performance outside the target domain Biderman et al. (2024) .
CoLA Zhou et al. (2025b) extends it with an efficient initialization scheme and three collaborative strategies between the low-rank matrices.
blocks.zh:
PEFT 方法 Ding等人(2023年)的性能与全细-调和相当,但仅更新了一小部分参数。
其中最被广泛采纳的LORA Hu等 (2022年),列车仅低-等级扰动到所选重量矩阵,这减少了内存使用. 它还概括了Xin等人(2024年)的强势性能,更好地维持了基准模型在目标域外的性能Biderman等人(2024年).
合作协会 Zhou等 (2025b) 将其扩展为高效的初始化计划和低等矩阵之间的三个协作策略.

blocks.en: LoRA scales poorly to multi-task settings, where each task typically requires a separate adapter. To address this, Liu et al. (2024) proposed MOELoRA for multi-task medical applications, and numerous MoE–LoRA methods have followed with different routing strategies and expert architectures.
blocks.zh: LoRA对多任务设置的尺度差,每个任务一般需要单独的适配器. 为了解决这个问题,刘等. (2024年)提出了MOELORA的多任务医疗应用,许多MOE-LORA方法都遵循了不同的路线策略和专家架构.

blocks.en:
Initial contributions proposed dynamic LoRA composition and highly parameter - efficient MoE for instruction tuning Huang et al. (2024) ; Feng et al. (2024) ; Zadouri et al. (2024) , followed by token - level and layer - wise variants Buehler and Buehler (2024) , multi - task ones such as MTLoRA Agiza et al. (2024) , and routing designed to mitigate world - knowledge forgetting Dou et al. (2024) ; Wu et al. (2024) .
Among the methods we compare, AdaMoLE Liu and Luo (2024) and AdaMoE Zeng et al. (2024) 2 2 2 AdaMoE implementation builds on the MoLA formulation Gao et al. (2025) , so the released configurations and run identifiers carry a mola prefix. select experts adaptively through threshold networks or null - expert designs, HydraLoRA Tian et al. (2024) reduces redundancy through an asymmetric structure, HMoRA Liao et al. (2025) combines token - and task - level routing across layers, MTL-LoRA Yang et al. (2025b) separates task - specific from shared representations, and MoV Zadouri et al. (2024) mixes vectors that inhibit and amplify inner activations Liu et al. (2022) .

blocks.en: These methods target instruction tuning and multi-task learning, not languages. Multilingual adaptation has instead relied on modular methods such as MAD-X Pfeiffer et al. (2020) , X-MOD Pfeiffer et al. (2022) , and MLAS-LoRA Dong et al. (2025) , which assign modules per language by construction rather than by routing. Routed multilingual work mostly targets speech recognition Song et al. (2024) ; Bagat et al. (2025) ; Kwok et al. (2025) , and MoE-LPR routes between full feed-forward rather than low-rank experts Zhou et al. (2025a) . LoRALib benchmarks MoE–LoRA methods, but not for multilingual adaptation Wang et al. (2025) . Routed low-rank experts under a shared multilingual CPT protocol at several language scales remain unstudied.
blocks.zh: 这些方法针对教学调和和多任务学习,而不是语言. 多语种改编则依赖于模块化方法,如MAD-X Pfeiffer等 (2020年),X-MOD Pfeiffer等 (2022年),和MLAS-LORA Dong等 (2025年),它们通过构建而不是路由来分配每个语言的模块. 路由多语种工作主要针对Song等人(2024年)、Bagat等人(2025年)、Kwok等人(2025年)和教育部-劳工和人民事务部在全方位、而不是低等专家之间的路线。 周等 (2025a) (中文(中国大陆) ). blocks.en: Early multilingual models showed that a single pretrained transformer can learn shared representations across dozens of languages Devlin et al. (2019) ; Conneau et al. (2020) , and large-scale multilingual LLMs have since extended this to hundreds of languages Workshop (2024) ; Srivastava et al. (2025) ; Yang et al. (2025a) ; Team et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 早期多语种模型显示,一个经过预先训练的单一变压器可以学习数十种语言Devlin等人(2019年)、Conneau等人(2020年)的共享表达方式,而大规模多语种LLMs从此扩展到了上百种语言(2024年)、斯里瓦斯塔瓦等人(2025年)、杨等人(2025年a; Team等 (2026) (英语).

blocks.en: A complementary line of work uses CPT as a cheaper route to multilinguality. Sailor2 Dou et al. (2025) applies block expansion and CPT on roughly 500 billion tokens for 15 Southeast Asian languages, and comparable efforts cover Japanese, Korean, and Indic languages Fujii et al. (2024) ; Vo et al. (2024) ; Nag et al. (2025) . Others study how language mixing interacts with CPT Li et al. (2025) or target selected layers with LoRA when adding new languages Owodunni and Kumar (2026) . We apply solutions from the multi-task domain to this setting and compare MoE–LoRA methods across languages and tasks.
blocks.zh: 互补的一行工作采用CPT作为实现多语种化的更便宜的路线. 水手2号 杜等编. (2025年)对15种东南亚语言应用了约5000亿令牌的块形扩展和CPT,类似努力包括了日语,韩语和印地语Fujii等(2024年);Vo等(2024年);Nag等(2025年). 其他人研究语言混合如何与CPT Li等(2025年)互动,或者在添加新语言Owodunni和Kumar(2026年)时,将选定层次与LORA互动. 我们将多任务域的解决方案应用到这个设置中,并比较语言和任务的MOE-LORA方法.

blocks.en:
The design is organized by the two quantities of Section 3 , the per-expert rank r r and the expert count E E . We use expert count throughout for what some methods call heads or projections, and where a method divides a total rank budget among its experts.

blocks.en: 4.1 Model and Training Data
blocks.zh: 4.1 模式和培训数据

blocks.en:
All experiments start from the frozen meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B checkpoint Dubey et al. (2024) , which supplies the pretrained parameters Φ \Phi of Section 3 .
English training text comes from FineWeb and the remaining languages from FineWeb2 Penedo et al. (2024) ; Penedo et al. (2025) . We use training sets of K = 10 K=10 , 96 96 , or 200 200 languages (see Appendix A.1 ). Each set takes the same fraction of every language’s available documents, so languages keep their relative sizes in FineWeb2 and low-resource languages receive no extra weight. Table A4 gives the resulting proportions.

blocks.en: 4.2 Methods
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 方法

blocks.en: The candidate pool covers AdaMoE, AdaMoLE, HMoRA, HydraLoRA, LoRA, MOELoRA, MTL-LoRA, and MoV, which routes vectors rather than low-rank matrices but demonstrates stronger performance than LoRA Zadouri et al. (2024) . They represent different ways of sharing or routing experts, and each can be trained in a single multilingual run.
blocks.zh: 候选队伍包括AdaMoE、AdaMoLE、HMORA、HydraLORA、LORA、MOELORA、MTL-LORA和MOV,它们沿向向量而不是低等矩阵行走,但表现比LORA Zadouri等人(2024年)强。 他们代表了不同的共享或路径专家方式,每个专家可以接受单一多语种的训练.

blocks.en: The search space is not a complete factorial grid, because not every method defines every factor and the number of settings per method differs. We therefore restrict controlled comparisons to configurations with shared coverage and give the full matrix in Appendix A.2 . Plain LoRA takes part in the shared rank panel, and its two best ranks there also serve as baselines in both broader regimes. They help separate the effect of the multi-expert structure from that of adaptation itself.
blocks.zh: 搜索空间并不是一个完整的因子网格,因为并不是每个方法都定义了每个因子,每个方法的设置数量也有所不同. 因此,我们把控制下的比较限制在有共同覆盖范围的配置上,并在附录A.2中提供完整的矩阵。 Plain LoRA参加共同的军衔小组,其两个最佳军衔也是两个更广泛的政权的基线。 它们有助于将多专家结构与适应本身的作用区分开来。

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3 评价

blocks.en: We evaluate the final checkpoint with the LM Evaluation Harness Gao et al. (2024) on four multilingual benchmarks. Belebele (Bele.) measures reading comprehension Bandarkar et al. (2024) , FLORES (FLO.) supplies parallel translation data Team et al. (2022) , SIB-200 (SIB) measures topic classification Adelani et al. (2024) , and Taxi1500 (Taxi) measures text classification Ma et al. (2025) . Together they cover both task accuracy and language-model fit.
blocks.zh: 我们通过LM评价Harness Gao等人(2024年),按照四个多语种基准对最后检查站进行评价。 Belebele (Bele.) 读取理解 Bandarkar 等 (2024) , FLORES (FLO.) 提供平行翻译数据 Team等 (2022) , SIB-200 (SIB) 测量专题分类 Adelani 等 (2024) ,和 Taxi (Taxi) 测量文本分类 Ma等 (2025) 。 它们共同涵盖任务准确性和语言模式适合性。

blocks.en: We count a training run as one configuration trained once and an evaluation run as one model measured on one benchmark and language pair, counting the two FLORES directions separately (Table A1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们把一个训练作为一次训练的组合来计算,把一个评价作为按一个基准和一对语言衡量的模型来计算,分别计算两个FLORES方向(表A1)。

blocks.en: We use accuracy for Belebele, SIB-200, and Taxi1500. FLORES is evaluated as a language-modeling task rather than by decoding, so we score it with bits-per-byte over the reference translation Gao et al. (2020) . Normalizing by bytes rather than tokens keeps this score comparable across languages. It measures how well a model fits translation data Magnusson et al. (2024) , so a FLORES gain is not evidence of better translation output. Lower values are better on FLORES, while higher values are better on the other three. Therefore, we invert FLORES before any comparison.
blocks.zh: 我们对Belebele、SIB-200和出租车1500使用精确度。 FLORES被评价为语言建模任务,而不是通过解码,因此我们比起参考翻译"高等"等(2020年)以比特-比特来评分. 由字节而非符使此分数正常化,保持了各语种的可比较性. 它测量一个模型与翻译数据Magnusson等人(2024年)的匹配程度,因此FLORES增益并不能证明翻译输出的更好. 较低值在FLORES上较好,而较高值在其他三个上较好. 因此,我们先倒置FLORES后再进行比较。

blocks.en: 4.4 Experimental Stages
blocks.zh: 4.4 实验阶段

blocks.en: We change one design choice at a time, first varying the rank r r while holding each method’s expert count fixed and then varying the expert count E E while holding the rank fixed. The balanced rank analysis uses r ∈ { 2 , 4 , 8 , 16 , 32 , 64 } r\in\{2,4,8,16,32,64\} across the six methods that cover every one of those values, and the expert-count analysis uses E ∈ { 2 , 4 , 8 , 16 , 32 } E\in\{2,4,8,16,32\} .
blocks.zh: 我们一次改变一个设计选择,先是改变r r 的级别,然后是固定每种方法的专家数,然后是固定的E E 专家数。 平衡分级分析使用r {2,4,8,16,32,64} r\\\\2,4,8,16,32,64} 6个方法,涵盖其中每一个值,专家计分分析使用 E {2,4,8,16,32} E\in {2,4,8,16,32}

blocks.en: The first stage leaves the two best values of each factor, r ∈ { 2 , 8 } r\in\{2,8\} and E ∈ { 16 , 32 } E\in\{16,32\} . Combining them per method and removing duplicates gives 22 configurations, which we train for 7.2 hours on the same ten-language data (Appendix A.5 ). Eight are new rank–expert combinations and the remaining fourteen repeat an earlier sweep setting at the longer budget, which separates the effect of combining choices from the effect of simply training longer. The five best benchmark-balanced configurations go to the broader validation, so that the broader regimes test the shortlist itself rather than a single bet on the top position.
blocks.zh: 第一阶段留下了每个因子的两个最佳值 r {2,8 } r\\\ \\ 2,8 } 和 E { { 16, 32 } E\ in 16, 32 { } 。 将每种方法进行组合并去除重复,给出了22个配置,我们在相同的十语数据(Appendix A.5 .)上训练了7.2小时. 八是新的军衔-专家组合,其余十四人重复了先前在更长的预算范围内的扫荡设定,这将合并选择的效果与单纯的更长时间训练的效果区分开来。 五个最佳的基准平衡配置将进行更广泛的验证,以便更广泛的制度对短名单本身进行测试,而不是在最高位置上单打一赌。

blocks.en: We train each of the five promoted configurations, plus plain LoRA at r = 2 r{=}2 and r = 4 r{=}4 , once with 96 training languages (34.5 hours per run) and once with 200 training languages (72 hours per run), and evaluate them against the unadapted base model. Runs within a regime are matched on wall clock, hardware, data, and optimizer settings, which are the usual constraints in practice. Equal wall clock is not equal data exposure, because methods differ in throughput. Details of resource accounting are provided in Table A3 . The two regimes differ in several factors at once, so we compare systems within each regime only.
blocks.zh: 我们培训了五个推广的组合,加上平地LORA = 2 r{=}2和r = 4 r{=}4,一次有96种训练语言(每跑34.5小时),一次有200种训练语言(每跑72小时),并对照未适应的基础模式对其进行评价. 制度内的运行在墙钟、硬件、数据和优化器设置上进行匹配,这是实践中的通常限制。 平面壁钟不等于数据曝光,因为吞吐量的方法不同. 资源核算的详细情况见表A3。 两种制度同时在几个因素上有所不同,所以我们只比较每个制度内的制度.

blocks.en: 4.5 Aggregation and Statistical Tests
blocks.zh: 4.5 汇总和统计测试

blocks.en: We reserve r r for the rank of a low-rank expert and use the term average position for the ordering of systems, which runs from 1 for the best system downwards. We compare systems only on matching benchmark, task, language, and metric cases, and within each case we order the systems from best to worst and record the position of each. We then average the two FLORES directions and give each of the four benchmark families equal weight, which keeps benchmarks with more evaluation cases from dominating the comparison.
blocks.zh: 我们为低级专家的军衔预留r,并使用术语平均位置来订购系统,从1起向下为最好的系统。 我们只根据基准、任务、语言和衡量案例来比较系统,在每种情况下,我们命令系统从最佳到最差,并记录每个系统的位置。 然后,我们平均衡量两个FLORES方向,并给四个基准家庭以同等的权重,这样就可以保持基准,使更多的评价案例无法主导比较。

blocks.en: For RQ 1 and RQ 2 we use one Friedman test per benchmark and report Kendall’s W W , which measures how far the individual evaluation cases agree on an ordering, from 0 (they disagree entirely) to 1 (every case gives the same ordering), so that a low W W means a benchmark does not separate the systems rather than that the systems are equal. Follow-up pairwise comparisons use two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, with each stated family of tests adjusted using Holm’s method.
blocks.zh: 对RQ 1 和 RQ 2 来说, 我们使用一个 Friedman 测试每个基准, 并报告 Kendall 的 W W W , 该测试衡量单个评估案例就订单达成一致的程度, 从 0( 他们完全不同意) 到 1( 每个案例给出相同的订单), 这样低 W W 表示一个基准不分离系统, 而不是系统是平等的 。 后续对等比较使用双侧的Wilcoxon签名排名测试,每个申报的测试家族都使用Holm的方法进行调整.

blocks.en: In each broader regime we run one Friedman test per benchmark over all eight systems, followed by two-sided paired Wilcoxon tests on every one of the twenty-eight system pairs, with Holm correction inside each regime and benchmark. A non-significant result means only that the available evaluation does not distinguish two systems, and never that those systems are equivalent.
blocks.zh: 在每一个更广泛的制度中,我们对所有8个系统进行每个基准的Friedman测试,然后对28个系统对中的每一对进行双侧对接的Wilcoxon测试,每个制度和基准内都有Holm校正。 非重大结果仅意味着现有评价没有区分两种系统,而且从未将这两种系统等同起来。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: All comparisons are reported as average positions (Section 4.5 ), where position 1 is best, so lower is always better, and the value says where a system places relative to the others rather than by how much. For brevity, the complete panels and the per-comparison statistics are in Appendix A , as tables numbered A1 onwards, alongside all the related details.
blocks.zh: 所有比较都报告为平均位置(第4.5节),即第1个位置最好,因此,较低位置总是更好的,而且价值说明一个系统相对于其他位置的位置,而不是多少。 为了简洁起见,完整的面板和每个比较的统计数字载于附录A,表编号为A1起,同时列出所有相关细节。

blocks.en: 5.1 Rank and Expert Count (RQ 1 )
blocks.zh: 5.1 军衔和专家数(RQ 1)

blocks.en: We varied one factor at a time on the ten-language data, comparing on balanced panels, that is, restricted to the values at which all compared methods were actually run. Table A6 gives the average positions and Table A7 the tests behind this section.
blocks.zh: 我们一次在十种语言的数据上就有一个因素,比较了平衡的面板,即仅限于所有比较方法实际运行的值。 表A6列出了本节的实际情况。

blocks.en: A rank of r = 2 r=2 has the best overall average position (2.49), with r = 8 r=8 second (2.72). Rank 2 leads on FLORES, SIB-200, and Taxi1500, whereas rank 8 leads on Belebele. Since adapter size grows with r r , the winning setting is also the smallest. Rank 2 trains roughly an order of magnitude fewer adapter parameters than rank 64. blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: The reduced-scale search gives a usable starting point. A low rank and a larger expert count are favoured on the ten-language data, and every configuration it promoted remained trainable at scale. What it does not give is an ordering, nor any guarantee of improving on the unadapted model, which places third of eight at 200 languages. The configuration ranked first at ten languages finished third in both broader regimes, and its ordering is uncorrelated with the one at 200. A short multilingual sweep is therefore a reasonable way to find viable configurations but an unreliable way to pick a winner. It also leaves open whether the configurations it discards are worse, since, of the two discarded configurations we retrained at scale, plain LoRA at r = 4 r{=}4 placed second at 200 languages.
blocks.zh: 缩小尺度的搜索提供了一个可用的起点. 在10种语言的数据中,偏好低级别和更大的专家计数,它所推广的每一种配置都仍然可以大规模训练。 它没有给出的是命令,也没有保证改进未适应的模型,将8种语言中的第3位置于200种语言. 组合以10种语言在两个更广泛的制度中排名第一,完成了第三位,其订购与200种语言无关。 因此,简短的多语种扫描是寻找可行配置的合理方法,但却是选择赢家的不可靠方法. 因为它所丢弃的配置是否更糟糕, 因为,在两种被丢弃的配置中, 我们按规模重新训练, Plain LoRA = 4 r{=}4 在200种语言中排在第二位。

blocks.en: MOELoRA and AdaMoE lead the controlled shared-rank comparison, yet different configurations lead once the selected factors are combined and the budget is extended, and different ones again in each broader regime. Combining selected values does not always help either, since the best mixed descendant fails to beat its preserved parent in two of six prespecified groups. One-factor trends therefore do not reliably compose, and no single leaderboard summarizes this method family. Routing does not cause this instability, as plain LoRA configurations also move between the two regimes. Practitioners should validate in the training regime they intend to deploy, because a shortlist assembled anywhere else does not rank correctly.
blocks.zh: MOELORA和AdaMoE领导了受控的共享排名比较,然而,一旦选定因素合并并扩展预算,不同的配置就会领先,在每一个更广泛的制度中也会出现不同的配置. 合并选定的价值并不总是有帮助的,因为最好的混合后代未能在六个预先指定的群体中的两个群体中打败其保留的父母。 因此,一个因素的趋势不能可靠地构成一个因素,没有一个单一的领导板可以总结这个方法家族. 跑步不会造成这种不稳定,因为平庸的LORA配置也在两个政权之间移动. 从业人员应在他们打算部署的培训制度中验证,因为汇集在其他地方的短名单排名不正确。

blocks.en: Across regimes, the effect of adaptation depends more on the benchmark than on the configuration. Belebele performance declines for all fourteen configuration–regime combinations. FLORES improves strongly at 96 training languages, although the benefit weakens at 200 languages for three of the seven configurations. Because plain LoRA behaves the same way on both benchmarks, the trade-off suggests a property of low-rank adaptation of a frozen multilingual model rather than of routing. MoE–LoRA adaptation as configured here is therefore a targeted tool, not a general multilingual upgrade.
blocks.zh: 在各个制度中,适应的效果更多地取决于基准而不是配置。 Belebele的性能在所有14个配置-制度组合中下降. FLORES在96种培训语言上有很大的改进,不过在7种组合中,3种组合的200种语言的好处减弱了。 由于平原LORA在这两个基准上的表现都相同,取舍意味着低排名地适应了被冻结的多语种模式而不是路由. 因此,这里配置的MOE-LORA适应是一个有针对性的工具,而不是一般的多语种升级.

blocks.en: One explanation is that continued pretraining benefits the two benchmarks differently. FLORES measures how well the model fits reference translations, so the multilingual text modelling learned during CPT can transfer to it. In contrast, CPT does not directly train the in-context discrimination required by Belebele. Adaptation may therefore improve language-model fit while weakening behaviour already present in the base model. Such forgetting has been documented when pretrained models are extended to new languages Zhou et al. (2025a) ; Li et al. (2025) , while low-rank adapters must balance learning new information against preserving existing capabilities Biderman et al. (2024) . Testing this would require a deeper look at sample-level performance, which remains a future work. A short replay stage using data from the base model’s original distribution as suggested by Zhou et al. (2025a) might help recover original-language ability but still would not explain why adaptation trades comprehension for language-model fit. Our released per-language results and analysis code let others place a new method into this protocol, or test whether the same outcome holds for their design.
blocks.zh: 一种解释是,继续预训对这两项基准的好处不同。 FLORES测量模型是否适合参考翻译,因此CPT期间学到的多语种文本建模可以传输到它. 相反,欧洲防止酷刑委员会并不直接训练Belebele所要求的内容内歧视。 因此,适应可能改善语言模式的适应性,同时削弱基础模式中已经存在的行为。 在将预训模式推广到新语言"周语等"(2025a),"李等"(2025),而低等适配器必须平衡学习新信息与保留现有能力Biderman等(2024). 测试这需要更深入地审视样本一级的绩效,这仍然是今后的工作。 使用由周等所推荐的基础模型原始分布数据进行短暂回放阶段. (2025a)可能有助于恢复原始语言能力,但仍无法解释为什么适应性交易对语言模型的理解适合。 我们发布的每种语言的结果和分析代码让其他人将新方法放入这个协议中,或者测试同一个结果是否适用于它们的设计.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Training all 166 configurations of the eight methods would cost more than 70,000 A100-hours across both broader scales. We therefore vary one design choice at a time and retrain only a shortlist, as is common practice Team et al. (2022) ; Üstün et al. (2024) ; Zadouri et al. (2024) ; Gao et al. (2025) . Apart from the plain-LoRA baselines, discarded configurations were never retrained at scale, so we cannot show that the shortlist contains the best ones. Each configuration is also trained once, and close rankings may change on retraining. Runs are matched on wall clock rather than on tokens, so faster low-rank configurations also see more data (Table A3 ). Benchmark coverage differs across stages and reaches only 136 of the 200 training languages. All results also come from a single base model and may not hold for others.
blocks.zh: 培训这八种方法的所有166种配置将花费70 000多A100小时,涵盖范围更广。 因此,我们每次改变一个设计选择,只重新培训一个入围名单,常见做法是Team等人(2022年);üstün等人(2024年);Zadouri等人(2024年);Gao等人(2025年)。 除了Plain-LORA基线外,被丢弃的配置从未在规模上重新训练,因此我们不能显示短名单中包含最好的配置. 每个配置也接受过一次培训,在再培训方面,接近的排名可能会有变化。 运行在墙上时钟上而非符上相匹配,因此更快的低等配置也能看到更多的数据(表A3. 各个阶段的基准覆盖面不同,在200种培训语言中只有136种。 所有结果也都来自一个单一的基础模型,可能不会为其他模型所持有.

blocks.en: Later work can introduce seeds, change the base model, evaluate generated translations with metrics such as BLEU or COMET, or move selection closer to the target regime. We release the configurations, per-language results, and analysis code so that later work need not repeat the search.
blocks.zh: 后期的工作可以引入种子,改变基模,用BLEU或COMET等度量衡来评价生成的翻译,或者将选择更接近目标制度. 我们发布配置,每个语言的结果,分析代码,这样以后的工作不需要重复搜索.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: This study involves no human subjects, annotation, or new data collection. The training text is derived from the web, and we apply no additional screening for personal or offensive content beyond the procedures used for the source corpora Penedo et al. (2024) ; Penedo et al. (2025) . Residual personal information and harmful content may therefore remain, although we do not redistribute any training text. Appendix A.7 documents the licenses and intended uses of the artifacts used and released in this study. In total, the 146 training runs consumed approximately 5,150 A100-hours.
blocks.zh: 这项研究不涉及人类课题、注释或新的数据收集。 培训文本取自网络,我们除了对来源corpora Penedo等人(2024年);Penedo等人(2025年)使用的程序外,没有对个人内容或攻击内容进行额外筛选。 因此,剩余个人信息和有害内容可能依然存在,尽管我们没有重新分配任何培训文本。 附录A.7记录本研究报告使用和释放的文物的许可证和用途。 146次培训总共耗时约5 150 A100小时。

blocks.en: A.1 Language Selection and Resource Labels
blocks.zh: A.1 语言选择和资源标签

blocks.en: Two released notebooks document how the training languages were chosen and how each language was labelled by resource level.
blocks.zh: 两本已发行的笔记本记录了如何选择培训语言以及每种语言如何按资源水平标出标签。

blocks.en: Resource labels are generated by data_sample/notebook/fineweb2_analysis_and_subsampling.ipynb , which builds the language table used throughout the paper. It starts from the FineWeb2 language distribution, drops the subsets marked as removed, and joins an external resource-category list from Chang et al. (2024) . Its original categories establish document-count boundaries, which are merged into the three levels we report, high, medium, and low, and applied to every retained FineWeb2 subset after sorting by document count.
blocks.zh: 资源标签由data_sample/notebook/fineweb2_analysis_和-subsampling.ipynb所生成,它构建了通篇所使用语言表. 它从FineWeb2语言分布开始,将被标记为已删除的子集放下,并加入从Chang等人(2024年)的外部资源类列表. 它最初的类别建立了文档计数边界,它们被合并到我们报告的三个级别,即高,中,低,并在按文档计数排序后适用于每个被保留的FineWeb2子集.

blocks.en: The language selection is generated by data_sample/notebook/lang2vec.ipynb , which chooses the languages we train on. It reads the labelled table, keeps the languages with more than a thousand documents in FineWeb2, and intersects them with the languages for which lang2vec provides a genetic distance Littell et al. (2017) . From that pool it applies greedy farthest-point selection, repeatedly adding the language furthest from those already picked, so that each smaller set is contained in the next larger one. It also reports how much of Belebele and FLORES each set covers.
blocks.zh: 语言选择由data_sample/notebook/lang2vec.ipynb生成,它选择了我们训练的语言. 它读取了标有标签的表格,保留了FineWeb2中一千多份文件的语言,并把它们与lang2vec提供遗传距离Littell等人(2017年)的语言相交. 从这个集合中,它应用了贪婪的最远点选择,反复添加与已经选择的语言相去最远的语言,这样每个更小的集合就包含在下一个更大的集合中. 它还报告Belebele和FLORES每套节目覆盖多少。

blocks.en: Four kinds of gap produce the uneven grids. First, some methods do not define a factor. Plain LoRA trains one adapter and so has no expert count, which is why it appears in the rank search only and why its two best ranks there, rather than a rank–expert pair, are what carries into the broader regimes; and MoV scales activation vectors rather than low-rank matrices and so has no rank, which is why it contributes a single run to the rank search. Second, some routing settings are degenerate. The expert-count search varies top- k k over the powers of two up to E / 2 E/2 , because k = E k{=}E routes to every expert and removes the routing being studied, and MoV is trained dense for the same reason. Third, some configurations did not fit the hardware. AdaMoLE at 32 experts exhausted memory on four A100 40GB GPUs at a per-device batch size of one, under both the all-target and the attention-only adapter placement, and MOELoRA at 32 experts with top- k k 16 was likewise infeasible, which is why those two cells are missing. Fourth, one method’s grid did not train reliably. AdaMoLE was not run in the rank search, because its higher-rank configurations did not train stably, so it is excluded from the shared rank panel.
blocks.zh: 四种差距产生出不均匀的网格. 首先,有些方法没有定义一个因素。 Plain LoRA训练了一个适配器,所以没有专家的计算,这就是为什么它只出现在军衔搜索中,为什么它的两个最好的军衔,而不是一个军衔-专家配对,是进入更广泛的制度的;而机动车的起动矢量比低,因此没有军衔,这就是为什么它为军衔搜索贡献一个跑步。 第二,一些路由设置退化. 专家计数搜索在两个至E / 2 E/2 的权限上- k k 不同, 因为 k = E k * 。 E通向每位专家并去除被研究的通路,而MoV也因为同样的原因接受了密集的训练. 第三,一些配置不符合硬件. AdaMoLE在32位专家的A100 40GB GPU上耗尽了4个A100 40GBGPU的内存,每个设备的批量尺寸是1个,在全目标及只注意的适配器的放置下,而MOELORA在32位专家的上-克16同样不可行,这就是这两个细胞之所以缺失的原因. 第四,一种方法的网格训练不可靠。 AdaMoLE没有在军衔搜索中运行,因为其更高级的配置没有被严格地训练出,所以被排除在共享军衔板之外.

blocks.en: We also implemented and trained CoLA Zhou et al. (2025b) , with eight runs in the rank search and five in the expert-count search. Those runs failed early, and we excluded the method rather than report it on unequal terms. CoLA is therefore absent from every count, table, and test reported here, and the 132 search runs of Section 4.4 are the 145 trained search runs minus these 13. The released workbooks retain the CoLA rows.
blocks.zh: 我们还实施并培训了COLA Zhou等人(2025年b),有8次排位搜索,5次排位搜索。 这些运作很早就失败了,我们排除了这一方法,而不是以不平等的条件报告。 因此,本文中每一次统计、表格和测试中都没有CoLA,第4.4节的132次搜索是145次训练有素的搜索,减去这13次。 发行的工作手册保留了CoLA行.

The ten-language stages evaluate nine languages, giving 42 task and language cases per model. The broader regimes evaluate 80 languages (249 cases) after training on 96, and 136 languages (408 cases) after training on 200.

blocks.zh: A.3 培训预算和语言组合

blocks.en: Table A3 reports the training budget of every system in both broader regimes. E E is the expert count and k k the number of experts routed per token, or dense where a method combines all of them. Steps counts optimizer steps, Tokens the input token positions processed, Tok./s the throughput, Corpus the share of the training set seen once, and GPU the hours on the run’s four A100 40GB GPUs. Every run in a regime received the same wall clock, so the spread in steps and tokens is the throughput difference between methods. That spread is large. At 200 training languages the systems process between 0.50 and 2.40 billion token positions, or between 13% and 61% of one pass over the training set. We report several indicators because they do not agree with each other Dehghani et al. (2022) . The system with the fewest trainable parameters sees the most data, and the system with the most trainable parameters is the fastest of the routed ones.
blocks.zh: 表A3报告两个较广泛的制度中每个系统的培训预算。 E E是专家数,K是每枚纪念品中的专家人数,或者在一种方法结合了所有这些专家的情况下密集度。 步骤数为优化步骤, 键入已处理的输入符号位置, Tok. /s 吞吐量, Corpus 所看到的培训集份额, GPU 运行时数为 A100 40GB GPU 。 一个政权中的每一跑都得到同样的壁钟,所以在阶梯和道具上的传播就是方法之间的吞吐量差异. 这个传播是很大的。 在200种培训语言中,系统处理0.50至2.4亿个象征性职位,或其中13%至61%通过培训。 我们报告了若干项指标,因为它们彼此不同意Dehghani等人(2022年)。 拥有最少数可被训练参数的系统看到的数据最多,而拥有最能被训练参数的系统是路由参数中最快的.

blocks.en: The same table gives the rank r r and scaling hyperparameter α \alpha of every system, as the implementation counts them. Across all 140 training runs with a low-rank update, α \alpha is twice that rank. MOELoRA counts the total rank budget, so its configurations carry r = 32 r=32 and r = 64 r=64 although the paper reports the per-expert rank of 2. Every implementation except HMoRA scales the update by α / r \alpha/r , which is therefore 2 2 in every run. For these methods the rank sweep does not change update magnitude. HMoRA specifically defines its own ratio of α \alpha to r r , scaling the update by α / r \alpha/\sqrt{r} , and we use that definition instead. With α = 2 ​ r \alpha=2r its factor is 2 ​ r 2\sqrt{r} , from 2.8 at r = 2 r=2 to 22.6 at r = 128 r=128 , so its seven rank-sweep runs vary rank and update magnitude together. Its expert-count runs all use r = 2 r=2 and share one factor. HMoRA is also not among the systems carried to the broader regimes. MoV scales vectors rather than low-rank matrices and has no α \alpha . The rank, α \alpha , and applied scaling factor of every run are released with the run metadata.

HMORA专门定义了自己的α-α与r r的比例,将更新缩放为 α/r-α/\sqrt{r},我们使用这个定义取而代之. 以α = 2 r\ alpha = 2r 其系数为 2 r 2\ sqrt{r},从 2.8 at r = 2 r = 2到 22.6 at r = 128 r = 128,因此其7个军衔- sweep 运行时的级别不同,更新时的星等会一起变化. 其专家点数全部使用r = 2 r = 2,并共享一个系数. HMORA也不属于更广泛的制度所包括的系统。 MoV 比例向量而不是低等矩阵,没有α-α. 每次运行的分级, α\ alpha, 以及应用的缩放因子随运行的元数据一同发布.

blocks.en: The Train. and Active columns separate trainable adapter parameters from those reached on a forward pass, since an expert that is never selected for a token contributes to the first but not the second. The two MOELoRA configurations activate 13.6M of the 27.3M and 54.5M they train, because they route to 8 of 16 and 8 of 32 experts. HydraLoRA and MTL-LoRA combine every up-projection with dense weights, so their two counts nearly coincide, as they do exactly for plain LoRA. AdaMoE selects a variable number of experts per token through its null experts, so its count is given as a range rather than a point value. Counts are derived from the saved checkpoint shapes together with each run’s routing settings, and they are parameter counts rather than FLOP estimates. The frozen backbone contributes a further 8.03B parameters to every system and is excluded from both columns.
blocks.zh: 列车和主动列将可列车适配器参数与前行通道上达到的参数分开,因为从未被选入标志的专家对第一个而不是第二个有贡献. MOELORA的两个配置激活了27.3M中的13.6M和54.5M,因为它们向16名专家中的8名和32名专家中的8名提供培训. 海德拉语Name LORA和MTL-LORA 将每一次上升的投影 和密集的重量结合起来, 所以他们的两个计数几乎吻合, 就像他们对平地LORA一样。 AdaMoE通过它的无效专家,每个符物选择一个可变数量的专家,所以它的计数被给出一个范围而不是一个点值. 计数来源于保存的检查站形状以及每个运行的路由设置,它们是参数计数而不是FLOP估计. 被冻结的骨干为每个系统提供了又一个8.03B参数,并被排除在两栏之外。

blocks.en: Table A4 gives the composition of each training set. Labels counts language–script labels, which exceed the nominal language count because a language can appear in more than one script, and Ex. counts packed training sequences of 1,024 tokens. Top-1 and Top-5 give the share of sequences held by the largest labels, and the 50% and 90% columns the number of labels needed to reach that share. Construction draws the same fraction of every language’s available documents, 0.0025 at 96 training languages and 0.005 at 200, so the mixture reproduces FineWeb2’s own distribution without upsampling low-resource languages. At 200 training languages five language–script labels account for half of the training sequences and 26 account for nine tenths, while the smallest label contributes about one sequence in a million. English is the one deliberate exception, set to the rounded median document target of the selected non-English entries rather than to its corpus share, which leaves it with 31 training documents at 200 languages. These are shares of the prepared split rather than measured per-run consumption, so they describe what each run could draw on and not what it saw. The broader-regime results hold for this mixture, which is one reason not to read them as the best achievable at 200 languages. Per-language document, sequence, and token counts are released with the analysis.
blocks.zh: 表A4列出了每套培训的构成情况。 标签计数语言–script 标签,它超过了名义语言的计数,因为一种语言可以出现在不止一个脚本中,而Ex.则计数被打包的培训序列为1,024个令牌. Top-1和Top-5给出了最大标签所持有的序列份额,50%和90%的列给出了达到该份额所需的标签数量. FineWeb2本身的发行量没有增加低资源语言的样本。 在200种培训语言中,5种语言的标注占培训序列的一半,26种占十分之九,最小的标注则贡献了大约一百万个序列。 英语是一个故意的例外,它被设定为选定非英语条目的四舍五入的中位文件目标,而不是其实体部分,这使它拥有31份训练文件,使用200种语言。 这些是准备分期消费的份额,而不是按每笔支出计量的,因此它们描述的是每笔支出所能利用的而不是它所看到的。 较广泛的监管制度的结果对这一混合物具有影响,这是不将其视为200种语言所能达到的最佳结果的一个原因。 随分析而发布的是每个语言的文档、序列和符号数。

blocks.zh: 表A9:每个混合后续组合的平均位置. 下调更好,粗体标出5个配置,以进行更广泛的验证。

blocks.en: Table A10: Effect of combining the selected rank and expert-count values. Cells are the parent’s average position minus the descendant’s, so positive values favour mixing and bold marks a positive overall effect.
blocks.zh: 表A10:将选定的等级和专家计算值合并的影响。 细胞是父母的平均位置减去后人的平均位置,所以正面的数值倾向于混合而粗体标志着积极的整体效果.

blocks.en: Table A11: Omnibus and pairwise tests for the mixed follow-up. The omnibus test covers all 22 configurations, while the pairwise columns cover the top three of the five promoted, which is every pairing of those three. Arrows point toward the descriptively better configuration.
blocks.zh: 表A11:混合后继的统取和对接测试. 总括测试涵盖了所有22个配置,而双向列则涵盖了被提升的5个前3个,即这3个中的每个配对. 箭头指向描述性更好的配置.

blocks.en: The 22 follow-up configurations are built as follows. We take the three best concrete configurations at each of the four selected factor values, then pair each method’s selected rank with every expert count and routing setting that the same method contributed to the expert-count selection, and remove duplicates. Table A9 orders all 22 of them, and Table A8 repeats the five that were promoted. Table A11 reports the omnibus tests over all 22 configurations together with two-sided Wilcoxon tests among the promoted top three, with Holm correction applied over the four omnibus tests and, separately, over all twelve post-hoc tests. That family was fixed after the ranking was known, so it is less conservative than the all-pairs correction used in the broader regimes. Table A10 isolates the effect of combining a selected rank with a selected expert count. It selects the best observed child within each prespecified parent group and is therefore descriptive. It should not be read as an unbiased estimate of the benefit of mixing design choices.
blocks.zh: 22个后续配置如下. 我们把四个选定系数值中的每个值的三个最佳混凝土配置,然后将每种方法所选定的等级与每个专家计数和路径设置相配,而同一方法有助于专家计数选择,并去除重复。 表A9订购了全部22个,表A8重复了升入的5个. 表A11报告所有22个配置的统括测试,以及升级后前三名的双面威尔克逊测试,其中Holm校正适用于4个统括测试,并分别适用于所有12个后霍克测试. 这个家族在排名已知后是固定的,因此它比更广泛的政权中使用的全派修正要保守. 表 A10 将选定军衔与选定专家计数合并的效果隔离出. 它在每个预先指定的父母群体中选择最受观察的儿童,因此是描述性的。 它不应被理解为对混合设计选择的好处的无偏见估计。

blocks.en: A.6 Complete Broader-Regime Tests
blocks.zh: A.6 完整的广义制度试验

blocks.en: Table A12: Every configuration against the base model in the broader regimes. Median difference and rank-biserial effect are signed so that positive favours the configuration. Median differences are in each benchmark’s own units and do not compare across benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 表A12: 国家 在更广泛的制度中,每个配置都与基准模型相对应。 中位数差异和分级效应被签名,这样正向偏好配置. 每个基准单位的中度差异不作不同基准的比较。

blocks.en: Table A13: Friedman tests over the eight systems in each broader regime. Q Q is the Friedman statistic and W W Kendall’s coefficient of concordance. Holm correction is applied over the four benchmarks within each regime.
blocks.zh: 表A13:弗里德曼在每个更广泛的制度中对八个系统的测试。 QQ是弗里德曼统计和W Kendall的调和系数. 对每个制度内的四个基准都适用全面矫正。

blocks.en: Table A12 reports the seven comparisons against the base model for each benchmark within each broader regime, and Table A13 the corresponding omnibus tests, with Holm correction over the four benchmarks within each regime. For the pairwise tests, Holm correction covers all twenty-eight system pairs inside each regime and benchmark, not only the pairs shown here, and the remaining pairs are released with the analysis code. Correcting over every pair rather than over a shortlist keeps the size of the correction family independent of which systems come out on top, which makes these comparisons more conservative than a pre-planned finalist-versus-base design would have been.
blocks.zh: 表A12报告每个更广泛的制度内每个基准的7个基准模型比较,表A13报告相应的总括测试,Holm对每个制度内4个基准进行校正。 对于双向测试, 霍尔姆校正覆盖了每个制度和基准内的所有28个系统对子,不仅这里显示的对子,其余对子也随分析码一起放出. 校正每对而不是短名单可以使校正家族的大小独立于上面的系统,这使得这些比较比预先计划的最终结果和基准设计更为保守。

blocks.en: Table A14: Percentage of evaluation cases won against the base model, by the resource level of the language.
blocks.zh: 表A14: 国家 按语文资源水平分列的对照基准模式赢得的评价案件的百分比。

blocks.en: Table A14 reports how often each configuration beats the base model, split by the resource level of the language, which follows the assignment described in Appendix A.1 . Low-resource languages dominate the evaluation population. Table A15 is the independent-noise check for Figure 1 . The base-model score appears on both axes of that figure, so a negative relationship could in principle be produced by measurement noise alone. Taking the base score from a different benchmark than the gain removes that path, and the negative relationship holds everywhere except Taxi1500.
blocks.zh: 表A14报告每个配置比起基准模型的频率,按照附录A.1所述任务的语文资源水平划分。 低资源语言在评价人群中占主导地位。 表A15是对图1的独立噪声检查。 基模分数出现在了该数字的两轴上,因此原则上只能由测量噪声产生负关系. 从与得分不同的基准中取出基分,消除了这条路径,除"出租车1500"外,消极的关系到处都存在.

blocks.en: Table A15: Spearman correlation between the gain on one benchmark and the base-model score on another. The diagonal is empty because it would take both values from the same benchmark.
blocks.zh: 表A15:一个基准的增益与另一个基准模型分数之间的斯皮尔曼关联. 对角是空的,因为它会从同一个基准取出两个值.

blocks.en: The complete artifact is available at https://github.com/dice-group/moe-study/tree/master . The mola prefix marks the AdaMoE implementation, whose runs appear as adamoe_1_* in the expert-count sweep. The same rule applies to every identifier in Table A9 .
